correctness.rationale: The definition is vertex subsets inducing maximum degree at most one, empty included. The three-way least-pivot recurrence partitions by exclusion, inclusion without a neighbor, or inclusion paired with a uniquely determined neighbor; every call strictly reduces W. Independently constructed both 16-vertex graphs from the literal adjacency definitions and exhaustively checked all 65,536 masks per graph, recovering coefficient vectors [1,16,120,384,528,144] and [1,16,120,384,544,240,32]. Exact common-neighbor counts (2 for every pair) and degree six substantiate (16,6,2,2) and equal spectrum; maximal sizes and multiplicities follow from exhaustiveness. No extrapolation to general graphs is made.
